opening.argument: The title expressly presents a Candy Crush hack offering free lives, gold bars, and moves, and the footage ties those promised benefits to participation in an external app. It instructs viewers to "Download 1 app and follow the instruction In order the complete Human verification," shows Final Fantasy XV being installed, and then directs viewers to "Open and Run for 30 sec" before returning to Candy Crush. This sequence makes external-app participation a condition of the purported reward. The available evidence does not establish whether the hack works, collects data, charges money, or produces the promised outcome, but it clearly promotes a low-barrier reward or asset acquisition through this app flow.
